in_hebrew.name: Fauch
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fauch הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'peteino', meaning 'to prick', and 'ornis', meaning 'bird'. In Greek mythology, the goddess Aphrodite was said to have transformed a young man named Phokos into a bird called the phoenix, which is symbolic of rebirth and renewal. This name, Fauch, is a nod to the little fowl, carrying the symbolism of rebirth and renewal, as well as the courage and loyalty often associated with birds.
